Messages.Author: Karl Innes
Messages.Body:
Bah have to come to the rulemongers for guidance yet again:)

Ok heres the scoop... When using cats guidance at the minor, (to
untap) when do you play this card???

1/ after the block is resolved, and before you enter the
determine range phase.

2/ or after the entire block is resolved (after strike
resolution) and the combat is over.

the other part of this ?? is can you use multiple untaps via
cats Guidance on an action using form of Mist??? (is it considered the
same action for the purposes of duplicate copies of the same reaction
card??)

Thanks, Karl

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Karl Innes <in...@infomatch.com> writes:
>Bah have to come to the rulemongers for guidance yet again:)
> Ok heres the scoop... When using cats guidance at the minor, (to
>untap) when do you play this card???

> 1/ after the block is resolved, and before you enter the
>determine range phase.

After the block is accepted (the acting minion declines to add stealth
and declines to play other block-avoiders (Horrific Countenance, etc)).

But Before Combat is entered.

(Basically, at the same time you would play Obedience - but only when
blocking).

> the other part of this ?? is can you use multiple untaps via
>cats Guidance on an action using form of Mist??? (is it considered the
>same action for the purposes of duplicate copies of the same reaction
>card??)

No - it is considered the same action.
